name: Xiao Guang
source:
Personification of Taiwanese fried chicken.

Personality: easily adaptable (chicken goes well with anything and is delicious!), stupid character, airhead
Likes: Games, delicious food, cute food, cute girls (especially [url=/c91267]Xiao Yuan[/url])
Dislikes: Cold (chicken doesn't taste good when it's cold), people who hate food
